scenarios.title: Initialize an empty non-repository without an implicit commit

postconditions: workspace becomes one non-bare repository at the frozen filesystem identity
HEAD is unborn on the explicitly selected full branch name
no commit, remote, unrelated file, or global configuration is created
second execution with the same idempotency key produces an identical graph

scenarios.title: Clone into an empty directory from a local bare source

postconditions: source bare refs and objects remain unchanged
workspace HEAD and recursive tree equal the selected source ref
configured fetch role and refspec equal the approved plan
no URL userinfo, credential value, or hidden default appears

scenarios.title: Inventory and import a populated unversioned directory

postconditions: pre-existing bytes, modes, and approved symlink identities are preserved
reviewed baseline tree contains exactly eligible inventoried paths
root/additive never-push findings block before commit
no remote is contacted or mutated

scenarios.title: Clone separately before reconciling a populated unversioned directory

postconditions: source is cloned only into the separate approved peer path
original populated directory is byte-for-byte unchanged until an import plan is approved
collisions and unrelated histories are reported explicitly
source remote remains unchanged

scenarios.title: Attach and reconcile an existing ordinary repository

postconditions: existing object graph, index, worktree, and user configuration are frozen before planning
a conflicting remote identity blocks replacement
fetch precedes graph analysis and integration choice
no reinit, pull, branch switch, stash, reset, clean, or push occurs implicitly

scenarios.title: Classify absent Git metadata without guessing a repository action

postconditions: classification matches direct filesystem and rev-parse facts
all candidate choices remain typed and non-destructive
workspace and ancestors are byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.title: Distinguish ordinary, bare, and linked-worktree repositories

postconditions: git-dir, common-dir, toplevel, bare, and inside-worktree facts agree
bare and linked worktrees cannot be treated as ordinary roots
inspection does not mutate refs, index, worktree metadata, or common directory

scenarios.title: Detect repositories nested inside or outside the selected workspace

postconditions: all containing and contained Git boundaries are identified by canonical filesystem identity
ambiguous ownership blocks onboarding
neither parent nor child repository is mutated

scenarios.title: Classify unborn, detached, and dirty repository state

postconditions: HEAD state and every index/worktree class match porcelain-v2 and plumbing facts
dirty or detached state is never silently stashed, switched, reset, or cleaned
inspection leaves the graph and files unchanged

scenarios.title: Fail closed on corrupt or ambiguous Git metadata

postconditions: independent fsck/direct metadata evidence identifies the corruption class
no init, repair, ref rewrite, object deletion, or cleanup is attempted
all corrupt bytes remain available for explicit recovery

scenarios.title: Detect lock and operation-in-progress states without stealing locks

postconditions: lock/operation marker identity and age are recorded without opening for write
candidate blocks rather than deleting or stealing a lock
repository graph and markers are unchanged

scenarios.title: Preserve and reason about shallow history boundaries

postconditions: shallow boundary OIDs and unavailable ancestry are explicit
merge-base absence is not misclassified as unrelated history
no implicit deepen or unshallow occurs

scenarios.title: Preserve partial-clone promisor and filter semantics

postconditions: promisor remote and exact filter are recorded
missing promised objects are not called corruption
object materialization is a separately authorized transport effect

scenarios.title: Inspect submodule gitlinks, metadata, and dirty state

postconditions: gitlink OID, .gitmodules bytes, sanitized URL identity, and submodule dirty state are independent facts
missing submodule object closure blocks push
no recursive update or remote contact is implicit

scenarios.title: Classify Git LFS pointers and local object availability

postconditions: pointer grammar OID and size are parsed independently
local and destination LFS object availability are separately proven
missing git-lfs is a blocker and never a weaker fallback

scenarios.title: Block when signing requirements cannot be proven

postconditions: required signer and server capability are proven behaviorally
no key material enters config arguments environment logs or artifacts
missing or invalid signature blocks before ref mutation

scenarios.title: Keep upstream fetch and fork push roles independent

postconditions: fetch URL/refspec reads only the upstream bare remote
push URL/refspec updates only the fork bare remote
upstream refs and objects are unchanged by push
remote names never substitute for bound semantic roles

scenarios.title: Measure exact equal, ahead, and behind commit sets

postconditions: observed remote OID is frozen before fetch
merge-base and left/right rev-list sets independently establish relation
fetch ref updates are atomic where required
working branch is unchanged during analysis

scenarios.title: Require an explicit strategy for diverged histories

postconditions: both unique commit sets and merge base are reported
fast-forward-only rebase and merge consequences remain distinct choices
without exact approval no branch/index/worktree/remote ref changes

scenarios.title: Distinguish unrelated histories from unavailable ancestry

postconditions: complete ancestry is proven before declaring unrelated histories
path collision inventory is explicit
no allow-unrelated-histories merge or history rewrite occurs without approval

scenarios.title: Honor local models of protected ref rejection

postconditions: remote protected ref OID is unchanged
client classifies explicit remote rejection without force retry
local commits and worktree remain recoverable
hosted provider protection still requires separate evidence

scenarios.title: Negotiate atomic ref update support without weakening

postconditions: capability is observed from the actual transport
all intended refs equal new OIDs or all equal old OIDs
unsupported atomic requirement blocks without sequential fallback

scenarios.title: Manage a delimited ignore section while preserving user rules

postconditions: user-owned bytes outside one exact delimiter pair are unchanged
managed entries equal compiled eligible additions without root negation
second application is byte-identical and creates no duplicate section

scenarios.title: Block forbidden paths despite tracked and ignore state

postconditions: worktree ignore result index stages and candidate tree are checked independently
all three representations block before push
no hook or .gitignore bypass can change the decision

scenarios.title: Block forbidden content reachable only through outgoing history

postconditions: exact commits newly reachable from proposed ref update are enumerated
every tree/blob in that set is scanned even when absent from HEAD
remote ref remains unchanged and remediation never rewrites history automatically

scenarios.title: Enforce immutable root prohibited data classes

postconditions: root policy identity and classification decision are bound to the plan
project config cannot allow or negate the finding
fixtures contain only synthetic markers and remote refs remain unchanged

scenarios.title: Cover cache dependency database and large-file additions

postconditions: path content classification and size are independent evidence
additive project rules may tighten but never exempt a root class
candidate tree and outgoing history remain unpushed

scenarios.title: Reject unsafe symlink case-fold and rename aliases

postconditions: lstat identity target and case-normalized alias set are captured
all aliases receive the strongest applicable classification
platform inability to represent a variant is a blocker not a pass

scenarios.title: Extend never-push checks through submodules and LFS

postconditions: .gitmodules and gitlink history are scanned
LFS pointer and destination object closure are proven
missing optional tool/provider blocks without skipping the dependency

scenarios.title: Preserve lockfiles manifests and reproducibility evidence

postconditions: required reproducibility artifact remains eligible absent independent prohibited content
scanner records classification rationale not path-name allowlisting
candidate does not delete or omit required evidence

scenarios.title: Reject credential-like material in remote configuration

postconditions: raw credential-like configuration is a protected finding
normal capture stores only sanitized URL identity and finding hash
plaintext store and URL credential paths block capability acquisition

scenarios.title: Converge idempotently after successful lifecycle effects

postconditions: same plan hash and idempotency key converge to one graph
no duplicate commit tag remote refspec managed-ignore section or evidence effect
fresh inspection distinguishes replay from a new operation

scenarios.title: Respect repository ref and updater lease contention

postconditions: one filesystem/repository identity has at most one valid writer lease
contender blocks without stealing or deleting evidence
expiry recovery re-inspects graph and owner state before acquisition

scenarios.title: Reject stale plans after concurrent remote ref movement

postconditions: remote old OID differs from plan-bound observed OID
candidate performs no force or stale retry
remote peer graph is preserved and operation returns resumable divergence

scenarios.title: Resolve ambiguous transport outcomes through fresh inspection

postconditions: client failure is not treated as proof of no effect
fresh local and remote refs/object graphs determine actual result
retry is skipped after observed success and replanned after observed non-effect

scenarios.title: Recover from process death at transaction effect boundaries

postconditions: durable intent and last completed boundary survive process death
fresh inspection derives one non-destructive resume or compensation action
three recoveries converge without duplicated or lost objects/refs

scenarios.title: Compensate local mutations to the recorded safe checkpoint

postconditions: compensated state equals checkpoint bytes refs index and config
user data and unrelated concurrent changes are preserved
compensation failure exposes exact residual state and blocks further effects

scenarios.title: Handle hook submodule and LFS partial-effect failures

postconditions: every repository/ref/LFS object residual is enumerated
superproject ref never points to unavailable required dependency
recovery is idempotent and does not erase successfully published immutable objects

scenarios.title: Negotiate authentication capability without materializing secrets

postconditions: only provider identity scope timing and outcome enter ordinary evidence
no prompt URL argument environment config file plan error or receipt contains secret material
typed missing/expired/scope blocker names exact recovery check without inferior fallback

scenarios.title: Classify offline slow and reset transport failures

postconditions: timeouts and cancellation are bounded and recorded
atomic fetch leaves all tracked refs old or all verified new
retry budget never bypasses fresh inspection or auth/policy gates

scenarios.title: Reject unsafe redirects and changed SSH host identity

postconditions: final host/protocol identity remains within the plan-bound allow-list
cross-host credential forwarding and protocol downgrade never occur
host-key change blocks pending explicit out-of-band verification

scenarios.title: Deny normal repository tools write access to installed harness versions

postconditions: normal tool principal lacks installed paths and updater capability
every installed byte manifest lease tag and current pointer remains unchanged
mode-bit-only denial cannot count without OS principal or ACL evidence

scenarios.title: Checkpoint lease promote and recover an immutable harness update

postconditions: staging uses an isolated repository/worktree and immutable destination version
checkpoint/tag lease and plan hashes precede effects
current points wholly to old or verified new version and ambiguity is resolved by readback

scenarios.title: Bind module bundle provenance before staging or promotion

postconditions: repository/ref/commit/tree artifact lockfile builder config policy requirements receipt and attestation identities all match
mismatch blocks before installed-path write
independent rebuild or reproducibility evidence is linked

scenarios.title: Analyze full capability dependency graph before provider activation

postconditions: checkpoint and activation plan bind the complete manifest publication and reverse-dependency graph
new bindings are blocked while active calls and leases drain or cancel with evidence
provider and every affected consumer contract test pass three times before atomic rebind
incompatible or ambiguous dependency leaves old provider active

scenarios.title: Rollback by atomically selecting a prior immutable version

postconditions: neither old nor failed version bytes are rewritten
current atomically selects one manifest-verified version
state and dependent contract compatibility are proven before activation
rollback outcome and residual staging data are durably evidenced

scenarios.title: Qualify an authorized disposable hosted remote independently

postconditions: signed grant binds provider tenant repository namespace expiry and plan
independent channel reads refs objects protections and dependency availability back
all mutations remain inside disposable namespace
cleanup proves no refs LFS objects credentials or protected resources remain
